data.name: This Flash Contains Horrors
data.detailed_description:
This Flash Contains Horrors is a collection of five short psychological horror games: GambleHeart, Romashka, You Are Doxxed, B*tch!, LOOP, and COLORFOOD Inc. Each experience explores anxiety, pressure, and internal tension through disturbing systems and unsettling environments. Each game lasts around 10–15 minutes and can be completed in one sitting.

GambleHeart - A short psychological horror game about gambling addiction and self-destruction. It feels like luck is finally about to smile upon you. But the closer the long-awaited jackpot seems, the more you have to lose.

ROMASHKA – A short psychological horror game where you’ve been promised easy money. There’s only one condition: follow the instructions on the tape, grow “special plants.” And don’t ask questions — just do what you’re told.

You Are Doxxed, B*tch! – A game where you’ve been doxxed. You must comply with every demand from an unknown hacker, or your life could be in danger.

LOOP – A short psychological horror game about a man who has lost control of his life. After being laid off, the main character tries to cope with despair through alcohol. With each passing day, reality becomes heavier, and his attempts to dull the pain only drag him further into a vicious cycle.

COLORFOOD INC. — a short psychological horror game about a person willing to do anything for money. You’ve taken a job at a factory that produces colorful sausages for children. The job seems simple: follow the instructions, avoid mistakes, and get paid.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 780
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: If you want to listen
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan support required. You need a flash drive for the first launch
